blocks.text: More personalities are speaking up against the hosts of the podcast “Machong Chismisan,” who recently published their vlog that made fun and mocked Joshua “Josh” Aquino, the special-needs firstborn son of TV host-actress Kris Aquino. Among them are Kris’ ex-boyfriend, Batangas vice governor Mark Leviste, who said he could not contain his anger after learning of the podcast hosts’ remarks against Josh, whom he said he loves like his own son. “I know #KuyaJosh personally. I love him like my own son, and my children love him like their own older brother. He is one of the kindest, sweetest, most prayerful, […]...
